aPlusContent.title: From the manufacturer
aPlusContent.rawText:
From the manufacturer
Segment's 1st Live Ai Translator 
Breakdown every language barrier with the groundbreaking realme Buds Air 7 Pro, featuring the first-of-its-kind AI Live Translation. Imagine conversing effortlessly across borders: simply speak, and your voice is instantly translated into 34 different languages, allowing you to communicate and understand with unprecedented ease. From navigating new cities to closing international deals or simply connecting with friends globally, the Air 7 Pro transforms your conversations into truly seamless interactions. Experience the future of communication – where every voice is understood, instantly. 
Golden Sound An Exclusive Hearing Experience 
It's not just sound; it's your sound, perfected. 
Unleash audio tailored precisely for you with the realme Buds Air 7 Pro and its revolutionary Golden Sound feature. This intelligent technology analyzes your unique ear canal and hearing characteristics, then customizes the sound profile to deliver a truly personalized, optimal listening experience. Every note, every beat, every word is presented with stunning clarity and richness, perfectly harmonized just for your ears. 
Unleash Endless Audio: Power That Never Quits. With the realme Buds Air 7 Pro, battery worries vanish. Dive into an extraordinary up to 48 hours of total playback, empowering you with days of non-stop music, podcasts, and calls – perfect for cross-country adventures or a full week of commutes. And when you're truly on the go, our lightning-fast charging ensures you're never without your soundtrack: just 10 minutes of charge delivers an incredible 11 hours of pure listening enjoyment. Say goodbye to interruptions and hello to an uninterrupted, immersive audio journey. 
Indulge in an auditory revelation with the realme Buds Air 7 Pro, a portal to pristine sound engineered with a groundbreaking 11mm + 6mm Dual-DAC Driver system that delivers profound bass from the powerful 11mm driver and meticulously sculpted crisp highs and crystal-clear vocals from the precision 6mm tweeter. Elevating your experience, Hi-Res Audio certification combined with LHDC codec support ensures your music is delivered in breathtaking, studio-grade quality – lossless, vibrant, and alive with every intricate detail, transforming your everyday soundtrack into an extraordinary, immersive performance. 
realme Buds Air 7 Pro: Experience premium elegance and robust durability. Crafted with an exquisite Aviation Aluminum Design, these earbuds are stunningly sleek, lightweight, and built with aerospace-grade strength. Elevate your style and enjoy lasting quality. 
Your World, Enhanced. Connect, Translate, Immerse. 
Step into the future of audio with the realme Buds Air 7 Pro. Experience pristine sound from revolutionary 11mm+6mm Dual-dac Drivers delivering unparalleled clarity and depth. Break down language barriers instantly with AI Live Translation, speaking to 34 languages in real-time. Stay connected with crystal-clear calls, even in noisy environments, thanks to 6-Mic AI Deep Noise Cancellation. Enjoy rock-solid, efficient wireless performance with Bluetooth 5.4, and take on any adventure knowing your earbuds are built tough with IP55 Dust & Water Resistance.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Premium Look, Great Features, Good ValuePremium Look, Great Features, Good Value
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: These buds try to bring flagship TWS features into the ₹5,000–6,000 segment, and I would say they succeed well. With dual drivers, LHDC support, adaptive ANC, spatial audio, wireless charging, multipoint connectivity, AI features, Golden Sound (customized audio profile after a sound test), and excellent battery life, the feature list is almost unmatched at its price.Design & Comfort – ★★★★★This is one of the strongest aspects of the earbuds.The charging case feels really premium which is unexpected at the price range, with an aluminum frame and leather-like finish. I bought the Glory Beige variant, and every single person who has seen it has commented positively about the look, most saying it's one of the best cases they've seen. If style/looks is an important factor for you, this is a great pick.The earbuds are lightweight, comfortable, and fit securely enough for long listening sessions or workouts. No ear pain issues or anything of that sort till now. IP55 water resistance adds peace of mind for daily use.Sound Quality – ★★★★☆The dual-driver setup has plenty of potential.But the first thing you'll notice is the bass. For me, the default tuning is aggressively bass-heavy. The vocals and mids take a back seat, making acoustic tracks and vocal-heavy music sound less natural.Thankfully, the Realme Link app offers EQ customization that significantly improves the balance if you're willing to spend a few minutes tweaking it.Here are my settings:EQ: -1, +1, +2, 0, +2, +3Dynamic Audio: 1, 5, -1It sounds really good with this, with a wider soundstage and way clearer mids.ANC – ★★★★☆Noise cancellation is genuinely effective.Low-frequency sounds like AC hum, airplane noise, buses, and engine rumble are reduced very well. It's among the better ANC implementations below ₹6-7k.Where it falls short is with higher-pitched sounds like conversations, cutlery, and keyboard clicks. But overall good.Transparency Mode – ★★★☆☆This is probably the weakest feature.Sounds somewhat artificial and not letting enough ambient sound through. It's usable for brief conversations but doesn't feel as natural as premium earbuds from Apple or Samsung.Call Quality – ★★★★☆Generally clear, especially indoor. Admittedly I haven't tested this as much, but have had no issues till now.Battery Life – ★★★★★Battery life has been really good. Real-world usage comfortably delivers a full day of use, and fast charging is excellent- just a short charge provides several hours of playback. I would say this is one of the strongest selling points of the Buds Air 7 Pro.Connectivity & Features – ★★★★★Realme packed almost everything you'd expect:Bluetooth 5.4Multipoint connectivityLHDC Hi-Res codecLow-latency gaming modeWireless chargingSpatial AudioExtensive customization via the Realme Link appAI translation featuresGaming latency is also well-controlled, making these a solid choice for casual mobile gaming.ValueThis is where the Buds Air 7 Pro really shines.For around ₹5-5.5k, you're getting features that often appear on earbuds costing ₹8,000–12,000. While not every feature is class-leading, very few competitors offer this combination of ANC, battery life, codec support, multipoint, wireless charging, and premium build quality at this price.ProsExcellent premium designComfortable fitPowerful bass with dual driversVery good ANC for the priceOutstanding battery lifeRich feature setGreat app supportExcellent overall valueConsBass-heavy default tuningMids and vocals can sound buriedTransparency mode is only averageVerdictThe Realme Buds Air 7 Pro is one of the easiest recommendations in the sub-₹6,000 category. It delivers premium hardware, excellent battery life, competent ANC, and a feature set that punches well above its price.Its biggest compromise is the default tuning. Audiophiles or listeners who prioritize natural vocals and balanced sound may find the stock sound overly bass-heavy, though just a few EQ adjustments help considerably and remove this negative point as well.Overall Rating: 4.5/5

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: A Promising Bud with a Fatal FlawA Promising Bud with a Fatal Flaw
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Realme Buds Air 7 ProOverall Rating: 3/5 (Based on personal experience with specific settings)I've been using the Realme Buds Air 7 Pro for about a month now, and my experience has been a mixed bag, leaning towards positive, but with a significant caveat regarding battery performance.My Setup & Usage:I've kept the buds' settings:ANC/Transparency: OffEQ Mode: Clear BassGolden Sound: OnSpatial Audio: OnVolume Enhancer: OffHigh-definition sound: OffDynamic audio: OffGame mode: OffDual-device connection: On (though only connected to a single device)Auto answer: OffVolume Level: Consistently below 50%The Good:Sound Quality (4.5/5): I'm genuinely impressed with the sound quality. The "Custom" EQ mode, combined with "Golden Sound" and "Spatial Audio," delivers a rich and immersive audio experience that I thoroughly enjoy for music, podcasts, and YouTube videos.Call Quality (5/5): Call performance has been consistently good. My voice comes through clearly, and I haven't had any complaints from people on the other end.Comfort & Fit (4/5): The buds are comfortable for extended wear, and they stay securely in my ears during daily activities. Sometimes feel discomfort.Low Latency for Video Editing (4.9/5): Accidentally, I used these buds for video editing (specifically with DaVinci Resolve) and was pleasantly surprised by the low latency. I didn't find any noticeable delay while cutting and editing clips, which is a significant plus for wireless connectivity.The Average:ANC & Transparency Mode (3.5/5): While present, both ANC and Transparency modes are, in my opinion, just average. They do offer some effect, but they don't stand out as particularly strong features compared to other earbuds I've tried. Given my preference to keep them off, this isn't a deal-breaker for me, but it's worth noting for potential buyers prioritizing these features.Additionally, the in-ear detection feature seems overly sensitive, as the audio sometimes plays and pauses unexpectedly even while simply chewing, which can be quite disruptive.The Concerning (Battery Life):This is where my experience takes a dip. Despite keeping ANC off and volume below 50%, I'm only getting a maximum of 7 hours of playback from the fully charged buds in a single stretch. The case provides about two full charges, bringing the total listening time with the case to roughly 22-25 hours, which is decent but not exceptional (at least 30-35 hrs would be good, according to the brand promise of 48 hrs).However, the most perplexing issue is the uneven battery drain between the left and right buds. I've observed a consistent trend where one bud (right) drains significantly faster than the other. Examples include 60-40%, 70-50%, 50-20%, and 40-10% differences. This discrepancy is quite noticeable and makes me question the longevity of one bud over the other in a single session. I'm unsure if this is a common characteristic of these buds or if my specific unit is faulty.The Realme Buds Air 7 Pro offers excellent sound and call quality for its price point. However, the average performance of ANC/Transparency and, more critically, the inconsistent and uneven battery drain between the left and right buds are significant concerns. If the battery drain issue is a widespread characteristic, it's something potential buyers should be aware of. If it's a fault with my unit, it's a frustrating flaw given the distance to the service center (~80 km).
